senses.definition: a structure that allows people or vehicles to cross an obstacle such as a river or canal or railway etc.

quotations.old_english: Ðæt he ne myhte to ðære brycge cuman
quotations.english: that he could not come to the bridge

quotations.old_english: Eádweard cyning hêt gewyrcan ða brycge ofer Treontan
quotations.english: king Edward commanded the bridge over the Trent to be built
